summary: Terraform plan checks derived from the Nile Governance Policy Catalog for required metadata, public exposure, selected identity and data-protection settings, and approved GCP regions.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). Policies read resource_changes[].change.after.

controls.title: Azure required tags present
controls.obligation: Azure resources subject to the tagging policy must include all required Azure tags.
controls.iac_check: For azurerm_* create/update resource_changes, change.after.tags must contain non-empty required keys.

controls.title: GCP required labels present
controls.source_section: Section 8 – Cross-Cloud Governance Intent; Section 11 – StackGen Validation Guidance
controls.obligation: GCP resources must include required labels mapped from the Nile tagging and labeling standard.
controls.iac_check: For google_* create/update resource_changes that support labels, change.after.labels, google_container_cluster.change.after.resource_labels, google_container_node_pool.change.after.node_config[].labels, and google_sql_database_instance.change.after.settings[].user_labels must contain non-empty required keys.

controls.title: No public IPs on Azure network interfaces
controls.obligation: Azure network interfaces must not expose public IP addresses.
controls.iac_check: For azurerm_network_interface create/update resource_changes, ip_configuration entries must not set public_ip_address_id.

controls.title: GCP compute instances deny external IP access
controls.obligation: GCP compute instances must not configure external IP access.
controls.iac_check: For google_compute_instance create/update resource_changes, network_interface.access_config must be absent or empty.

controls.title: Azure App Service HTTPS only
controls.obligation: Azure App Service and Function App resources must enforce HTTPS-only access.
controls.iac_check: For azurerm_app_service, azurerm_linux_web_app, azurerm_windows_web_app, azurerm_function_app, azurerm_linux_function_app, and azurerm_windows_function_app create/update resource_changes, https_only must be true when present.

controls.title: Azure storage secure transfer required
controls.obligation: Azure storage accounts must require secure transfer.
controls.iac_check: For azurerm_storage_account create/update resource_changes, enable_https_traffic_only or https_traffic_only_enabled must be true.

controls.title: Azure Key Vault soft delete and purge protection enabled
controls.obligation: Azure Key Vault resources must enable soft delete and deletion protection.
controls.iac_check: For azurerm_key_vault create/update resource_changes, soft_delete_retention_days must be greater than 0 and purge_protection_enabled must be true.

controls.title: Azure managed identity required on app services
controls.obligation: Azure App Service and Function App resources must use managed identity.
controls.iac_check: For supported azurerm app/function resources, identity.type must be present and non-empty.

controls.title: GCP approved resource regions only
controls.obligation: GCP resources with regional or zonal locations must use approved regions.
controls.iac_check: For google_* create/update resource_changes with location, region, or zone, values must match the approved region set encoded in policy.

controls.title: Active vs candidate/deferred control classification
controls.obligation: Candidate, deferred, higher-scope, approval, review, exception, evidence, and maturity statements must not be represented as Terraform plan denials unless a concrete resource attribute is defined.

controls.title: Human approval and GitHub pull request requirements
controls.obligation: Production-impacting changes require GitHub pull requests, human review evidence, and approval by designated reviewers.
controls.iac_check: Process-only requirement not present in Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Exception documentation requirements
controls.obligation: Policy exceptions must be documented with owner, rationale, approval reference, and expiration date.
controls.iac_check: Process-only requirement not present in Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Production readiness review obligations
controls.obligation: Backup posture review, logging architecture approval, Defender posture review, and other production readiness checks require human review and supporting evidence beyond Terraform plan shape.

controls.title: Open questions and TBD items
controls.obligation: Unresolved governance decisions must remain marked TBD and not be treated as enforced controls.
